name: leak_critical_event
description: RMC subscribes for events; a critical leak is injected; RMC must receive LeakDetectedCritical.

subscribe.description: RMC registers a push (webhook) subscription. No RegistryPrefixes filter: bmcweb filters sendEvent()-generated leak events out of registry-filtered subscriptions, so the RMC subscribes broadly and matches the specific leak event by MessageId/Severity below.

trigger.description: Inject a critical leak: set leak_sensor_1 -> Critical in STATE_DB.

expect_event.description: Within 15s, an event for leak_sensor_1 (LeakDetectedCritical, severity Critical) must arrive. OriginOfCondition must point at the LeakDetector under the Chassis this BMC actually serves (/redfish/v1/Chassis/chassis).

teardown.description: Restore leak_sensor_1 to OK so later tests start clean.

name: leak_recovery_event
description: After a leak, clearing it must produce a LeakDetectedNormal recovery event.

subscribe.description: RMC registers a push (webhook) subscription. No RegistryPrefixes filter: bmcweb filters sendEvent()-generated leak events out of registry-filtered subscriptions, so the RMC subscribes broadly and matches the specific leak event by MessageId/Severity below.

trigger.description: Let the critical event settle before clearing.
Clear the leak to drive a recovery event.

expect_event.description: Within 15s, a LeakDetectedNormal event (severity OK) must arrive; the intermediate Critical event is skipped by the matcher.

name: leak_sensor_fault_event
description: A faulted leak sensor must not look healthy: thermalctld reports it Fault/N-A, the detector becomes Unavailable with Status UnavailableOffline/Warning at both URIs, and the RMC receives ResourceStatusChangedWarning.

subscribe.description: RMC registers a push (webhook) subscription. No RegistryPrefixes filter: bmcweb filters sendEvent()-generated leak events out of registry-filtered subscriptions, so the RMC subscribes broadly and matches the specific event by MessageId/Severity below.

trigger.description: thermalctld reports leak_sensor_1 faulted (leaking N/A, leak_sensor_status Fault).
The deprecated LeakDetector URI the event points at reports Unavailable / UnavailableOffline / Warning.
The canonical LeakDetector URI reports the same.

expect_event.description: Within 15s a ResourceStatusChangedWarning event (severity Warning) must arrive with OriginOfCondition pointing at the LeakDetector.

name: leak_sensor_fault_recovery_event
description: A sensor coming back from Fault must be reported healthy again: Status Enabled/OK and a ResourceStatusChangedOK event for the RMC.

subscribe.description: RMC registers a push (webhook) subscription. No RegistryPrefixes filter: bmcweb filters sendEvent()-generated leak events out of registry-filtered subscriptions, so the RMC subscribes broadly and matches the specific event by MessageId/Severity below.

trigger.description: Let the fault event settle before recovering.
thermalctld reports the sensor Good and not leaking again.
The LeakDetector reports OK / Enabled / OK again.

expect_event.description: Within 15s a ResourceStatusChangedOK event (severity OK) must arrive for the LeakDetector; the earlier Warning event is skipped by the matcher.

name: leak_sensor_fault_recovery_reports_normal
description: Recovering from Fault to not leaking also delivers LeakDetectedNormal, so a subscriber matching only on the Environmental leak messages learns the sensor is back.

subscribe.description: RMC registers a push (webhook) subscription. No RegistryPrefixes filter: bmcweb filters sendEvent()-generated leak events out of registry-filtered subscriptions, so the RMC subscribes broadly and matches the specific event by MessageId/Severity below.

trigger.description: Let the fault event settle before recovering.
thermalctld reports the sensor Good and not leaking again.

expect_event.description: Within 15s a LeakDetectedNormal event (severity OK) must arrive for leak_sensor_1.
